parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the switches on the wall switch panel, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a control mechanism to open or close an electrical circuit, turning power on or off to connected devices.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by a small rotational or push action when pressed by the user.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch on the wall switch panel, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, allowing independent operation of connected devices.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward or outward when toggled by the user.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the third switch on the wall switch panel, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides control for another electrical output, functioning similarly to the other switches.
parts.Movement_description: It moves through a small press or toggle motion to activate or deactivate the circuit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the wall switch panel, made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the switches and sockets, ensuring electrical insulation and safety.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall surface.
